SUMMARY SHEET ON THE 1941 SEP 21 EARTHQUAKE (SHEET 2 OF 4)

Dongshan - Felt by persons at rest
- A few people heard noise
- Hanging objects swung slightly

Xianyou - Felt by persons at rest
- Hanging objects swung slightly

Lingxian - Felt by persons at rest
Zixing ~% min - About 1/10 population heard noise
- Felt by persons at rest and on
upper floors
- Tiles rattled
Qingliu - Hanging bells rang
Meixian - Falling of plaster dust from roof
- Pendulum clocks stopped
Dabu - Falling of plaster dust from roof
- A few walls cracked
Shicheng - Falling of plaster dust from roof
Yudu - Falling of plaster dust from roof
Pinghe - Falling of plaster dust from roof
Lianping - Falling of plaster dust from roof
Mingxi - Falling of plaster dust from roof
Shangyou - Falling of plaster dust from roof
Taihe ~5 sec - Vibrations felt like passing of heavy
trucks
- Felt indoors
Changding 13:50 - Felt outdoors

- Many ran outdoors

- Hanging objects swung

- Falling of plaster from old damaged
walls

- Noise heard
